items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I was a regular on that show, and so was Charlie, and so was Teddy.

ctx.x:
Yeah. Well, I played with Paul Baron, because Paul used to do the Mildred Bailey show, and on that show she used a lot of jazz musicians on that show. Teddy Wilson used to play it. Charlie Shavers played it; Stuff Smith played quite a few of those shows, and sometimes Mary Lou Williams would sit in on some of those shows.

Yeah, we did it regularly. I was a regular on that show, and so was Charlie, and so was Teddy.

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Trummy Young is going to come from Honolulu, with guys from California.

ctx.x: Yeah, those are all right. Yeah. What I like about those, it's like a reunion, I see fellows there I only see once a year. Trummy Young is going to come from Honolulu, with guys from California.
